# Pog Raid

A guild home base for **World of Warcraft: Forever**. Type **/pog** to open it.

## Home
Your guild at a glance: guild logo and name, message of the day, who's online, level-ups and achievements, recent guild chat, a level spread chart and recent blue-and-better drops.

- **Message board.** Officers post announcements, everyone with Pog Raid can comment in the thread. Posts can be pinned.
- **Group finder.** Post what you're doing and who you need. Listings show how full the group is (2/5) and expire after 45 minutes. Guildies can request to join with one click, and you get a pop-up to invite them.

## Raid leading
- **Raid Plans.** Draw on the raid's own map, or sketch a room from scratch with walls, zones and pen strokes, then place raid markers, players, role groups, arrows and labels. Press "Show to raid" and it pops up on everyone's screen, with their own spot highlighted.
- **Roster.** Build raid rosters from your guild with drag and drop: 10, 20 or 40 players, bench, tanks and healers marked by hand, available / tentative / out, composition counts, one-click invites, and automatic group arranging. Copy the roster for Discord.
- **Attendance.** Records itself while you lead a raid: snapshots every few minutes and after every boss, bench credit, and each raider's attendance over the last 4 and 8 nights and all time.
- **Loot log.** Who got what, from which boss, on which night, with main spec / off spec tags. CSV and Discord export.

## Crafting
- **Who can make it?** Search any recipe and see which guildies know it, online crafters first, with a click to whisper them. Works for crafters who are offline too.
- **Profession directory.** Every profession in the guild, who has it, their skill, and how many recipes they know.
- Your professions share themselves. Open each profession window once and your recipes join the search.

## Games
- **Wowdle.** A daily WoW word puzzle, the same word for the whole guild, with everyone's results for the day.
- **Sapper Sweeper.** Minesweeper with Goblin Sapper Charges, in Apprentice, Journeyman and Expert, with a guild leaderboard.
- **Gem Cutter.** Slide and merge gems up to a Large Opal, with a guild best-score board.
- **Ranked Duels.** Challenge a guildie, duel, and the result counts once both addons agree. Chess-style ratings and a win/loss leaderboard.

## Settings
- Minimap button (easy to hide), sounds, pop-ups, which guild ranks count as officers, and who in the guild has Pog Raid and on which version.

## Notes
- Shared features (message board, group finder, crafting, leaderboards, duels, raid plans) need guildies to run Pog Raid too.
- Built for big guilds: shared data catches up in small pieces within the game's message limits, and raid plans always go first.
- Keep your guild on the same version: 0.12 reads data from older versions, but older versions can't read 0.12's. Pog Raid tells you when a newer version is out.
- Officers are the top two guild ranks by default; change it in Settings.
- Everything is stored per account, in the game's SavedVariables. No outside services.
